$Comment: The crossover between the two characters: Orrin asks for worn iron hatchets to be unmade at
the table, and the iron they give back carried across the landing to Sawyer Marn, who is
Npc.ViewId names Orrin, so he is who OFFERS it; there is no TurnInId, because the quest does
not end at him. unmake_hatchets counts iron hatchets the tables took apart ('Tool_Hatchet_Iron'
on EXACT, since only the iron grade's salvage returns iron ore, qualified to
'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both tiers count, with its own TextKey so the objective
reads as the errand rather than the kind's generic line). carry_iron is Order 2, an exact-id hand-in of iron
ore whose TurnInNpcId names the SAWYER's role id rather than 'giver', so the ore can only be
delivered to Marn: an iron hatchet's salvage return is two iron ore, so three iron hatchets
fill the count. Keep the two Amounts in step if either changes. TurnInAt names Marn as well, so the
reward is collected from his quest list, and CompletionDialogue names his conversation, so
settling it plays his next line. Marn's own footer already carries a hand-in line for anything
ready at him, so his conversation needs no row of its own for this quest.
Requires names both characters' first jobs (a table to unmake at, a mill to carry to) beside
the stations feature. Rewards sit in Claim: Enchanting XP for the unmaking and Woodcutting XP
for the mill, split evenly, since the job belongs to both.
Name: Iron_For_The_Mill
